FN-CX3U2WJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 60
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/19/2026
Senate Bill 60 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Corrections
(DOC) by an undetermined amount to: 1) search for and serve arrest warrants on inmates in
DOC custody, under certain conditions; 2) provide notification to warrant issuing entities; and
3) provide access to inmates to attend pre-trial hearings virtually, under certain conditions.
Page 1

FN-CX3U2WJ-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 60
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/30/2026
Senate Bill 60 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Department of
Corrections (DOC) by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to: 1) search for and serve
arrest warrants on inmates in DOC custody, under certain conditions; 2) provide notification to
warrant issuing entities; and 3) provide access to inmates to attend pre-trial hearings virtually,
under certain conditions.
